items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: whether I’m talking to you and Tim

ctx.x: If I see you go like this I know that we’ve got to go out.

No, if anybody goes out, you’re going out because I’ll sit here all day and talk about this because I love this music. Anything I can do to preserve it and keep it alive is what I’m here for. This is my calling, whether I’m talking to you and Tim, whether I’m teaching it, whether I’m singing it or whether I’m just listening to it. It’s my calling.
The years you spent with a day job, did that make the gigs and recordings you were able to do more precious?
